checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly marked as non-official and is eligible for content review; the full package must be recalculated when an official polygon is supplied.
All three required provisional key areas are present, non-overlapping, inside the site and visibly disclosed as non-official.
Eighteen land-use polygons cover the site union with no material gap or overlap in EPSG:4548.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.
Chinese and English proposals, reports, visual pages, five figures, A3 booklets and A0 boards are present and aligned under the v2 bilingual contract.
All four final PDFs were rendered page by page: 22 pages total, no empty pages, no Poppler font or syntax errors, and embedded Chinese and English font subsets.
